items.title: Police investigate as nearly 30 Santa Barbara half-marathon runners fall ill with ‘unusual symptoms’
items.summary: Runners seek medical treatment as 13-mile race held amid unusually high November temperatures

items.title: Petition calls for traffic lights to replace crosswalk in North York neighbourhood where child was struck
items.summary: Nearly two weeks after an eight-year-old girl and her grandmother were struck by a vehicle in a North York neighbourhood, residents are bringing their concerns about the crosswalk where the collision happened to Toronto City Hall.

items.title: Milton teens charged after victim from Niagara Region defrauded in ‘grandparent scam’
items.summary: Two teens from Milton are each facing several charges in connection with a “grandparent scam” that saw a victim from Niagara Region defrauded of a large sum of money, police say.

Ottawa doubles maximum time employer can hire low-wage temporary foreign workers
items.summary: The government said restrictions on hiring temporary foreign workers in cities with unemployment rates above six per cent will remain in place.

items.title: Toronto's living wage keeps rising. How much do workers need to earn to make ends meet?
items.summary: A new Ontario Living Wage Network report finds that there is no region in the province where the minimum wage covers basic costs.
